observation.command: TOKEN=$(grep '^API_BEARER_TOKEN=' /workspace/web_application/.env.local | cut -d= -f2-); echo "token length: ${#TOKEN}"; echo "=== super admin user ==="; docker exec vereinfacht-database-1 mariadb -uverein -pverein verein -e "SELECT id,email FROM users WHERE id=1;" 2>&1; echo "=== authenticated API request ==="; for ep in clubs members users; do echo -n "/api/v1/$ep -> "; curl -s -m 15 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Accept: application/vnd.api+json" -o /tmp/resp.json -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" "http://localhost:3001/api/v1/$ep"; done; echo "--- sample body (clubs) ---"; curl -s -m 15 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Accept: application/vnd.api+json" "http://localhost:3001/api/v1/clubs" | head -c 400; echo
